title: Douglas City Hall
geometryBasis: Mapped ten-vertex Douglas Town Hall outline, the 1900 municipal building description and two original 2013 Qualla exterior photographs.
sectionBasis: Dressed Manx rubble with Bath stone facings, stepped gable and oculus, rectangular sash with stone mullions, metal-roofed square turret and projecting clock.
limitations: The main gable, window group, plaque and projecting clock follow the 2013 views. The roof layout, windows and ornament outside the photo coverage and precise dimensions are approximate.
The 1900 description places the main entrance on John Street. Its bay, door detail and exact threshold are approximated using the local grade.
The DEM field is unchanged and supports approximate grade contact. The pre-2024 exterior represents the photographed date.
